'''Mulaen''' is a woman from [[Seanchan]], likely a ''[[sul'dam]]''. 

==History==
Mulaen is a woman from Seanchan and probably an old ''sul'dam''. She run the ''[[damane]]'' quarters in [[Falme]].

She has a droning, nasal voice, but she is very sharp to any ''damane'' who does not remember every word of her lectures.

She put [[Min]] in a dress and burned her coat and breeches, because she decided that Min ranked with a serving girl
